task_description: Rotate the log of a service chosen by name (web, worker, scheduler).
Save an uploaded file under its original name.
Read a schedule file for a given week such as 2026-W14.
Read the help page for a command name chosen from the menu.
Write a JSON export under a given name.
Parse a range header into start and end bytes.
Reset a settings file by profile name (default, compact, wide).
Load a game save file for a player name.
Move a file from the inbox folder to an archive folder.
